lateral_flank_blob_constellation.centroid_triangulation: High-intensity circular clusters arranged in four to five identifiable horizontal rows posterior to the gill slits, with the largest centroids concentrated in the mid-lateral region.
lateral_flank_blob_constellation.stripe_intersections: Visible vertical linear segments of elevated luminance intersecting the horizontal blob rows to form a Cartesian-like grid of anchor nodes across the central flank.

carinae_gradient_vectors.ridge_trajectory: Visible as three parallel longitudinal ridges; the primary carina displays a sharp light-to-shadow gradient running from the posterior gill region to the caudal peduncle.

dorsal_fin_surface_patterning.internal_spot_density: Non-uniform distribution of approximately 5-7 distinct high-luminance blobs localized within the anterior and mid-sections of the dorsal fin silhouette.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Bright white scarring or tissue loss visible on the distal tip of the lower caudal lobe.
other_distinctive_markers: Multiple remoras attached to the posterior margin and ventral surface of the visible right pectoral fin.
